captures.description: THE ORTHONYM READ AS KÜNSTLERROMAN, THE COUNT READ UNRENDERED: ChatGPT reads leesharks.com as a work about the production of authorship — all twelve heteronyms including Ichabod Spellings, the three mantles, the Prize and its origin in Pearl's credential line — and gives 1,520 deposits, the page's unrendered fallback figure.

atoms.evidence: If we treat the whole of leesharks.com as a literary work
Lee Sharks attempts something analogous in digital form.
At the most official level, Lee Sharks is presented as an “orthonym”: the anchoring authorial identity of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive
the anchoring authorial identity of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive
The homepage calls itself an “orthonym wing”; the site's own description says the visitor moves through a threshold hall, wing doors, a reader, a prize wall, and eventually a deeper descent.
The homepage ends with the remarkable statement that the facts on the wall are not typed by hand.
